'''Wendin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the Cold War, he commanded the Republic forces on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[General/Legends|General]] Wendin was in charge of the Republic forces of the planet.<ref name="Enemies" />

During the year [[3643 BBY]], Wendin sent Republic forces to recover an [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] computer from the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. They encountered and an Imperial presence in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] and the ruins, which was also trying to find the computer. The computer contained secret hyperspace routes discovered by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hundreds of years ago, and it would give either side a powerful advantage in the Cold War.<ref name="Enemies" />

An individual acting on behalf of the Republic recovered the device for the Republic, and gave it to General Wendin at his command center in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]].<ref name="Enemies" />

==Behind the scenes==
General Wendin was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. he appears in the Coruscant Heroic Mission "Enemies of the Republic", where he accepts the astrogation computer that the players retrieved from the Temple.
